title: Same Task, Different Statement: When and How Reformulation Helps LLM Problem Solving
abstract: arXiv:2611.14997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When people face a hard problem, they often restate it in a clearer way before solving it. We study whether the same habit helps large language models by rewriting the statement of a problem. A legal rewrite must keep the meaning, the constraints, and the correct answer unchanged. We test three kinds of rewrites. Decomposition makes hidden subgoals explicit. Typed Reformulation casts the task into a more suitable solving frame. Concept Reduction removes surface detail and exposes the task structure. We evaluate them on eight math, logic, and code benchmarks with eight models, all under the same chain-of-thought solving prompt. The effect is large but depends on the problem type. An oracle that picks the best rewrite after the fact raises accuracy by +27.6% on average. Yet no single rewrite helps every problem, and a mismatched rewrite can hurt. Still, the effect follows clear patterns. Each kind of rewrite fits certain problem types. A s

translated_title: 同一任务，不同表述：改写何时以及如何帮助大语言模型解决问题
translated_abstract: 当人们面对一个难题时，往往会在解题之前先用更清晰的方式重新陈述问题。我们研究同样的习惯是否能帮助大语言模型，即通过重写问题的表述来提升其解题能力。合法的改写必须保持问题的含义、约束条件和正确答案不变。我们测试了三种改写方式：分解使隐藏的子目标显式化；类型化重构将任务转换到更适合求解的框架中；概念精简去除表面细节并凸显任务结构。我们在八个数学、逻辑和代码基准上，使用八个模型，在相同的思维链求解提示下对这些方法进行评估。其效果显著但取决于问题类型：一个事后选择最佳改写方式的神谕平均可将准确率提升27.6%。然而没有任何一种改写对所有问题都有效，不匹配的改写甚至可能造成负面影响。尽管如此，其效果遵循清晰的规律，每种改写方式都适合特定类型的问题。
tldr: 该研究提出三种问题改写策略（分解、类型化重构、概念精简），证明重写问题表述能显著提升大语言模型的解题准确率（神谕选择最佳改写时平均提升27.6%），但效果依赖于问题类型，需根据问题特征匹配合适的改写方式。
en_tdlr: This study proposes three problem reformulation strategies—decomposition, typed reformulation, and concept reduction—showing that rewriting problem statements can substantially improve LLM problem-solving accuracy (+27.6% on average with an oracle), though the benefit depends on matching the rewrite type to the problem type.
